Previous imageNext imageSlide 1 of 2, Daily Mirror back page, Mirror back pageEnd of image galleryPublished1 hour agoAston Villa midfielder Boubacar Kamara is on Chelsea's summer watchlist, Liverpool are prepared to wait to sign loanee Ronald Araujo on a permanent deal and Manchester United could make a huge offer for Nottingham Forest's Murillo.
Chelsea, Inter Milan and Al-Hilal have all put Aston Villa's Boubacar Kamara on their watchlist after the 26-year-old France midfielder's return from injury. (Fussball News - in German), external

Both Liverpool and on-loan Uruguay defender Ronald Araujo plan to wait until the end of the season before deciding whether to turn the 27-year-old's move from Barcelona into a permanent switch for £47m. (Sport - in Spanish), external
Manchester United could be ready to make a huge offer for Nottingham Forest's Brazil centre-back Murillo, 24, in the summer. (Football Insider), external

If Manchester United sack head coach Michael Carrick, 45, then former Newcastle United manager Eddie Howe, 48, and ex-Germany, Bayern Munich and RB Leipzig boss Julian Nagelsmann, 39, remain the top two candidates to replace him. (Manchester Evening News), external
However, USA head coach Mauricio Pochettino, who managed Tottenham and Chelsea in the Premier League, is the new bookmakers' favourite to replace Carrick at Old Trafford. (Standard), external
Brentford, Chelsea, Fulham, Manchester City, Newcastle United and Tottenham are among a number of sides monitoring 21-year-old French defender Ismaelo Ganiou, who plays for Lens. (Teamtalk), external
Everton are ahead of Sunderland and Coventry City in the race to sign 19-year-old Ivory Coast midfielder Abdoulaye Doumbia from Swedish side BK Hacken. (Football Insider), external
Liverpool, Manchester United and Chelsea head a list of Premier League clubs monitoring the form of AC Milan's Belgium centre-back Koni de Winter, 24. (Caught Offside), external

Everton are admirers of Kelvin Yeboah - the son of ex-Leeds United striker Tony - and are interested in completing a deal in January for the former Italy Under-21 forward, who has scored 18 goals in 32 games this season for MLS side Minnesota United. (The Hard Tackle), external
But Crystal Palace and Ipswich Town are ready to rival Everton in their pursuit of Yeboah, 26. (Football Insider), external

Everton, Chelsea, Manchester United and Tottenham have all been in contact with the representatives of former Barcelona forward Vitor Roque, 21, with the Brazil international valued at £42m by Palmeiras. (Bolavip via Teamtalk), external

Manchester United made an approach for Manchester City defender Rayan Ait-Nouri, 25, in the summer and could make another attempt to sign the Algeria international in January. (Football Insider), external
